authorization.operator_question: For the Bias Bounty Mapping Equity Challenge we would like to validate our estimators on an external lab: the same coverage-gap recipe applied to about 10,000 2020 census tracts in nine US state groups that contain none of the four study regions and no tract sharing an edge with one, using the reference layers that were removed from the participant package (TIGER/Line 2024 prisecroads, Microsoft US Building Footprints, USGS National Structures, CBP/ZBP 2023) plus the same Overture release. No lab value would ever be joined to a study GEOID or enter a submission artifact; the scored submission uses only provided data. Is building and reporting such an external lab permitted under the rule that removed reference layers or equivalent copies obtained elsewhere must not be used to recreate or approximate the targets, or is it permitted only as Best Bias Discovery documentation? May weights fitted on other US geographies using public TIGER/MS/USGS/CBP be applied to provided-data features? And are the provided `usfs_BuildingCount_sum` / `carbonplan_buildings` columns usable as features?
authorization.operator_question_note: retained verbatim for the record because the spec's own combined question also asks whether the provided usfs_BuildingCount_sum and carbonplan_buildings columns are usable as features; the operator answered the lab question and no question goes to the organisers

And are the provided `usfs_BuildingCount_sum` / `carbonplan_buildings` columns usable as features?"
